description: This PHP class 'EmployeeJoinedDateChangedEvent' defines an event that is triggered when an employee's joined date is changed within the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates the employee entity and optionally the previous join date, providing accessor methods for these properties.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Pim\Event\EmployeeJoinedDateChangedEvent
classes.description: An event class representing a change in an employee's joined date, holding references to the Employee object and the previous join date.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with an Employee object and the previous joined date.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this event.

methods.name: getPreviousJoinedDate
methods.description: Returns the previous joined date, if available.
